title: Phase 2 - customer receivable automatic creation (government compensation)

storage.value:
User Story

As a system user,
I want the system to automatically create receivables for the customer after generating billing run with government compensation,
so that the customer’s balance is always accurate and up-to-date.

 

For general information about government compensation:

Compensation Flow - Invoice Doc, Receivable/Liabilities

 

Acceptance criteria:

  1. Automatically created Receivable object should be displayed in the Customer Receivable listing page as a new record

  2. Receivable is created automatically from invoice which was generated by billing run with government compensation

  3. Receivable should not be generated with amount zero

  4. fields should have the following state:

 

 

 

Number

  • Should be generated automatically by the system

Accounting period

  • Disabled

  • It should be displayed according to the billing run

Creation date

  • Disabled

  • Automatically filled by the system

Due date

  • Disabled

  • Should be displayed according to the 'Payment deadline' field from the invoice/debit note

Date of full offset

  • disabled

  • offsetting date

Occurrence date

  • same as creation date

Initial amount

  • Should be taken from government compensation amount with minus

  • If a compensation's currency differs from the system currency, it is converted to the system currency using the applicable exchange rates and then summed by their period

Initial amount in other currency

  • Should be calculated automatically by the system

Current amount

  • Current amount equals to zero as it is already offset with customer liability

Current amount in other currency

  • Should be calculated automatically by the system

Currency

  • system currency

Outgoing document from an external system

  • empty

Basis for issuing

  • takes value from original invoice

Direct debit checkbox

  • Selected if it is defined in the customer which is added in government institution

    1. In this case, Bank, BIC and Bank Account fields should be filled accordingly

  • Unselected if in the customer which is added in government institution

    1. In this case, Bank, BIC and Bank Account fields should be empty and optional

Additional receivable information

  • empty

Number of income account

  • takes value from original invoice

Cost center / Controlling order

  • takes value from original invoice

Blocked for liabilities offsetting checkbox

  • Unselected

  • Disabled

  • Enabled during editing

  • Following fields should stay disabled when receivable is created automatically and Blocked for liabilities offsetting checkbox is not selected

    1. Blocked from date

    2. Blocked to date

    3. Reason

    4. Additional information

 Sub-objects

 

 Sub-objects

 

Customer

  • Should be displayed according to the government institution customer in government compensation object

Billing group

  • Billing group from invoice

Alternative recipient of an invoice

  • empty

Offsetting

  • liability of customer indicated in the invoice

Outgoing document

  • Invoice

 Customer feedbacks
